analytics.question: Which villages have the most unresolved cases?
analytics.answer: Villages with unresolved cases. village: Neemgaon, unresolved: 17. village: Lotuspur, unresolved: 15. village: Sonapur, unresolved: 11. village: Rampur, unresolved: 11. village: Jasminpur, unresolved: 8. village: Palashpur, unresolved: 5.
analytics.sql: SELECT json_extract(data,'$.village') AS village, count(*) AS unresolved FROM cases WHERE json_extract(data,'$.status') NOT IN ('CLOSED','INTAKE') GROUP BY village ORDER BY unresolved DESC
analytics.provenance: Includes synthetic historical and live demonstration cases; intake drafts excluded where relevant.

analytics.question: What percentage of visits were independently confirmed?
analytics.answer: Independent visit confirmation. reported_visits: 115, confirmed_visits: 84, confirmed_percent: 73.0.
analytics.sql: SELECT count(*) AS reported_visits,sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(data,'$.feedback.visit_confirmed')=1 AND coalesce(json_extract(data,'$.feedback.verification'),'independent farmer account')!='single-account roleplay' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_visits,round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(data,'$.feedback.visit_confirmed')=1 AND coalesce(json_extract(data,'$.feedback.verification'),'independent farmer account')!='single-account roleplay' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/nullif(count(*),0),1) AS confirmed_percent FROM cases WHERE json_extract(data,'$.visited_at') IS NOT NULL
